title: leggedrobotics/pace-sim2real
abstract:
PACE: A systematic approach for sim-to-real transfer of legged robots, identifying actuator and joint dynamics with standard joint encoders.

# ⚙️ PACE — Sim-to-Real Transfer for Legged Robots PACE is a framework for **sim-to-real transfer of diverse robotic systems**, combining data-driven system identification with evolutionary optimization. It enables accurate actuator modeling and robust adaptation between simulation to reality by explicitly learning physically meaningful dynamics parameters. --- ## 🤖🐾 What is PACE? PACE (Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution) bridges the gap between simulation and real hardware by: * Estimating actuator and joint dynamics directly from measured data * Using CMA-ES for parameter optimization * Applying learned parameters to improve sim-to-real locomotion performance * Supporting multiple robot platforms and actuator types It is designed to integrate seamlessly with **NVIDIA Isaac Lab** and follows its task and environment conventions. --- ## 📦 Installation ### 1. Install Isaac Lab Follow the official Isaac Lab installation guide: [https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html](https://isaac-sim.github.io/IsaacLab/main/source/setup/installation/index.html) We recommend using the **conda** or **uv** installation method, as this simplifies running Python scripts from the terminal and managing dependencies. ### 2. Clone this repository Clone or copy this project separately from the Isaac Lab installation (i.e. outside the `IsaacLab` directory): ### 3. Install PACE in editable mode Using a Python interpreter that has Isaac Lab installed: ### ⚠️ Isaac Sim version compatibility PACE is developed and tested against **Isaac Sim 5.0 / Isaac Lab (latest)**. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：PACE（Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution）用数据驱动的方式采集激励轨迹数据，再以 CMA-ES 进化优化拟合物理可解释的执行器与关节动力学参数，并把学到的参数回填到仿真中，依托 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 完成多平台、多类型执行器的 sim-to-real 迁移。


# 一、动机

> 腿足机器人从仿真迁移到真机时，执行器与关节动力学建模不准确会导致控制策略性能骤降，而现有辨识方法往往依赖昂贵的力矩传感器或额外的专用测量设备，难以仅凭标准关节编码器完成标定。


# 二、方法

> PACE（Precise Adaptation through Continuous Evolution）用数据驱动的方式采集激励轨迹数据，再以 CMA-ES 进化优化拟合物理可解释的执行器与关节动力学参数，并把学到的参数回填到仿真中，依托 NVIDIA Isaac Lab 完成多平台、多类型执行器的 sim-to-real 迁移。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 提供的摘要与 README 未给出任何具体量化指标（如迁移后的跟踪误差下降百分比、成功率、参数辨识误差等），仅声称可在多个机器人平台与执行器类型上工作，并与 Isaac Sim 5.0 / Isaac Lab 版本兼容；定量结论需查阅论文正文。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于仅凭标准编码器可观测性有限，辨识精度受激励轨迹设计与真机数据质量影响，CMA-ES 的优化开销与真机实验成本也较高；启发性在于把「物理参数辨识 + 黑盒进化优化」作为 sim-to-real 的通用前置环节，可复用于不同本体与执行器，为本体迁移与硬件协同设计提供了低成本标定思路。
